coordinate_space: logical well-local; world origin is defined by the unchanged PR1 geometry recipe

calibration.guide_rule: water plane y69 minus pail base offset12.5 minus clearance2.5 = hook y54. The PR1 aperture-entry point y60 describes the opening, not a hook target.
calibration.contact_rule: water_contact is the pail BASE reaching water plane; mouth_submerged is the pail MOUTH reaching it. Filling requires the latter.
calibration.layer_rule: Guide remains loading_foreground until it reaches y54, where the entire pail clears water and near rim. Lower/raise use shaft; secure switches to loading_foreground at the same clear y54 before returning continuously to loading y74.
calibration.idle_rule: Bare hook and its rope remain at the reachable loading point even when the actor owns the pail.
calibration.motion_approval: Mechanism geometry is calibrated for the staged preview; later actor and live integration reviews remain required.
calibration.hook_rule: Compact hook attachment is1logicalunit below its rope anchor. Rope endpoint = bucket grip+[0,-1]; at guidedgrip54 the endpoint meets rope origin53, allowing zero visible rope with continuous support.
calibration.operator_station_rule: Joint review of the new authored left-facing operating key moved the operator from PR1 provisional [566,874] to [564,866]. This remains clear for the complete player24x12 and gardener12x8 probes and brings natural arms to the actual centered crank orbit. PR1 artwork/physical support stays unchanged.
calibration.loading_station_rule: Joint review of the authored back-facing key moves loading from PR1 provisional [528,900] to [528,894]. The full player24x12 probe begins at y888, immediately beyond the retained solid support ending at y887; the gardener12x8 probe is also clear. With draw anchor [24,36], the natural authored grip [24,16] reaches hook world [528,874] at the transfer cue. Visual foot registration remains distinct from the probe center by4logicalunits. This station change removes the six-unit overreach without stretching arms or changing PR1 artwork/physical support.

interpolation: linear constant-rate winding within each timed movement; positions and crank angle remain continuous across phase boundaries
ownership_policy: Reservation and pail ownership are distinct. Attachment transfers actor→well at its cue; detachment transfers well→actor at its cue. Abort returns an explicit recovery location without silently moving or duplicating the pail. Global reset requires coordinated actor reset at integration.
clock_policy: Controller owns functional time. Readiness gates discard elapsed input and require explicit station readiness. Presentation samples immutable snapshots and never performs transfers. No game or actor object is read.
limits: Additive staged controller contract only. No live town selection, existing well/gardener mutation, player interaction, audio playback or journey serialization.
